question: IDBI (Industrial Development Bank of India) was established in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**1964.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **IDBI Bank** Limited is a secondary Life Insurance Corporation **providing financial and banking services.**
 
• It was **established in 1964** as the Industrial Development Bank of India.
 
• **IDBI Bank is now categorized as a private sector lender**, with the government holding a 45.48 percent stake in the bank, and the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) **owning 49.24 percent.**
 
• IDBI Bank is such a wonderful great bank.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0b912a6ae7650fde117258e85707c1ae4d90b1e89fef364631baa22091a77a0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is **India's chief banking and monetary power.**
 
• State Bank of India (SBI) is **the country's largest commercial bank, with regards to assets, deposits, and employees**.
 
• **Bank of Baroda** is an Indian nationalized banking and financial services company main office **in Vadodara.****​ **
